capabilities: process capture JSON files from the macOS Shortcuts iCloud inbox
generate titles, categories, tags, summaries, and key points for each capture
fetch readable page text and metadata for URL-only captures
deduplicate captures by URL or content fingerprint and retry failed ones
write notes with YAML frontmatter into category subfolders
extras: Desktop-only, macOS only, because it reads the iCloud Shortcuts folder via Node.js filesystem APIs. No telemetry. README includes a copy-pasted official submission checklist and a sponsor (爱发电) link. Defaults to local heuristic organization and falls back to it when a model provider fails.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn captures collected on an iPhone with Apple Shortcuts into organized, formatted vault notes.

relations.evidence: You can also configure a local Ollama endpoint or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint in the plugin settings.
OpenAI-compatible mode sends capture text to the configured endpoint and uses the API key stored in the plugin settings.

requires.name: Apple Shortcuts with iCloud inbox on macOS

summary: Capture pipeline that reads .glintcapture.json files from the Apple Shortcuts iCloud inbox, organizes them, and writes Markdown notes into the vault.
